item.title: Elegant Antenna Design: The Four-Band Octagon Dipole
item.description:
You know what I appreciate? When someone takes a complex problem and solves it with elegant engineering instead of brute-force complexity.

Robert, N6MRO, designed a four-band ham-stick dipole that does exactly that. It’s a multi-band antenna that works efficiently on 10, 20, 40, and 80 meters without the complexity usually required for such performance.

item.title: MagSafe Node Antenna Mount: Elegant Engineering
item.description:
Robert, callsign N6MRO, solved a problem I didn’t know existed, and the solution is so elegant that I had to document it.

The problem: Standard mesh node antennas are either permanently mounted (which means uninstalling the whole antenna to adjust orientation) or loosely attached (which means they fall off). There’s no elegant middle ground.

Robert’s solution: Steal Apple’s MagSafe concept and apply it to LoRa antennas. Magnetic quick-disconnect antenna mounts.
